bilingual.heading: Written for every guest
bilingual.text: Arabic invitations aren’t translations with the words flipped. Each design is typeset right-to-left with Arabic calligraphy, Hijri dates and Arabic numerals — and bilingual invitations let guests switch language with a tap.

faq.heading: Questions, answered
faq.q1: How do I receive my invitation?
faq.a1: Your invitation is a private web page with its own link. We email you a preview first; once you approve it, the link is ready to share on WhatsApp, by text, email or social media.
faq.a2: Most invitations are ready for your review within 3–5 business days of receiving your details. Need it sooner? Add express delivery at checkout.
faq.a3: Of course. Review your preview and tell us what you’d like changed — wording, names, timings. We refine it until it feels right.
faq.a4: Guests reply right from the invitation — through a short form, a pre-filled WhatsApp message, or a link of your choice. You can also have replies collected in a private guest-list spreadsheet.
faq.q5: Can I have my invitation in Arabic and English?
faq.a5: Yes. Choose “Bilingual” and we’ll create both versions, linked by a language switch, so every guest reads it in their language.
faq.a6: We focus on digital invitations — nothing is shipped. Your invitation is designed to look beautiful on every phone.
faq.q7: Can I add music or a photo?
faq.a7: Yes — send us your song and a favourite photo, and we’ll add them to your invitation.
faq.a8: Life happens. Get in touch and we’ll update the date, time or venue on your invitation — your guests always see the latest details at the same link.

about.heading: Why we started
about.text_html:
When we planned our own celebration, we wanted an invitation that felt personal and elegant — and that worked beautifully for guests reading in Arabic and in English. We couldn’t find it, so we made it.

Today every Maison invitation is designed by hand, set with care in both languages and delivered as a single link your guests will return to until the big day. No apps, no clutter — just the moment your story begins.
about.value_1_text: Every invitation is set by a person, not a template engine.
about.value_2_text: Arabic is never an afterthought — it’s typeset with the same care.
about.value_3_text: No paper, no ink, no shipping — just a beautiful link.
